name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ExposedRoot.colocated_part
title: Co-located slots: if two blocks are active on the same single prefix, every reachable row has parts β_π X_c and β_π X_d with one common coefficient β_π
statement: For a finite index set Q, a family β : Q → Matrix a n R and π : Q, the sums over q of β q * (if q = π then X else 0) equal β π * X, for X = Xc and X = Xd.
